title: Expired Youth Modpack
description: Modpack for the ExpiredYouth discord server. Any who also wish to use may download!
body:
ExpiredYouth is a lightweight Vanilla+ Fabric modpack designed to enhance the Minecraft experience without changing core gameplay mechanics.

This pack focuses on quality-of-life improvements, client and server performance, and subtle audiovisual upgrades while preserving the authentic vanilla feel. It is ideal for players who want Minecraft to run smoother and feel more polished — especially those who don’t have as much time to grind or stay AFK.

What this modpack includes:

⚡ Performance and optimization mods for smoother gameplay

🧠 Server-friendly enhancements that maintain vanilla mechanics

⏱️ Chunk-ticking improvements that reduce the need to stay AFK

🔊 Sound and audio enhancements for better immersion

🎨 Carefully selected shaders and resource packs

🛠️ Quality-of-life tweaks that do NOT alter core progression

Design philosophy

ExpiredYouth aims to be true Vanilla+. Nothing in this pack is meant to feel “modded” in the traditional sense. There are no game-breaking additions, no progression overhauls, and no major balance changes — just a cleaner, smoother, more convenient Minecraft experience.

Who is this for?

- Players who want vanilla Minecraft, but better

- Busy players who can’t spend hours AFK

- Servers that want improved performance without changing core gameplay

- Anyone who enjoys subtle polish over heavy modding

Originally built for the ExpiredYouth server, but fully available for anyone to use and enjoy!
